t: Câu điều kiện loại 3 & hỗn hợp
th: **Loại 3** – giả định về quá khứ: If + had + V3, **would have + V3**. If I had studied harder, I would have passed. (Thực tế: đã không học, đã trượt.)
**Third** – imagined past: If + had + V3, **would have + V3**. If I had studied harder, I would have passed. (Reality: I didn't study, I failed.)
**Hỗn hợp quá khứ → hiện tại**: If + had + V3, **would + V**. If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.
**Mixed past → present**: If + had + V3, **would + V**. If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.
**Hỗn hợp hiện tại → quá khứ**: If + quá khứ đơn, **would have + V3**. If I weren't afraid of flying, I would have gone with you.
**Mixed present → past**: If + past simple, **would have + V3**. If I weren't afraid of flying, I would have gone with you.
Đảo ngữ trang trọng (bỏ if): **Had I known**, I would have told you.
Formal inversion (no if): **Had I known**, I would have told you.
vo: to feel sorry about a past action
ex: If she had left earlier, she ___ the train.
If I ___ the map, we wouldn't have got lost.
If he had accepted the job in Tokyo, he ___ in Japan now.
Hỗn hợp: kết quả ở hiện tại (now).
Mixed: the result is in the present (now).
___ I known about the problem, I would have helped.
Ý nghĩa thực tế: “If you had warned me, I wouldn't have made that mistake.”
Real meaning: “If you had warned me, I wouldn't have made that mistake.”
Bạn đã cảnh báo, tôi không mắc lỗi.
You warned me; I didn't make the mistake.
Bạn không cảnh báo, tôi đã mắc lỗi.
You didn't warn me; I made the mistake.
If I weren't so busy, I ___ to your party last night.
If we had booked earlier we would have got better seats
Nếu đặt sớm hơn, chúng tôi đã có chỗ tốt hơn.
Had I known, I would have told you.

warm.s: If I had listened to my teacher's advice and started revising in January, I wouldn't be so stressed about the exam now.
q: Người nói tiếc điều gì?
What does the speaker regret?
o: Không bắt đầu ôn từ tháng Một
Not starting to revise in January
e: Câu hỗn hợp: If + had + V3 (quá khứ không có thật) → wouldn't be … now (kết quả ở hiện tại). Thực tế: đã không nghe lời, không ôn từ tháng Một, nên giờ rất căng thẳng.
A mixed conditional: If + had + past participle (unreal past) → wouldn't be … now (present result). In reality the speaker didn't listen or start in January, so is stressed now.
f: If I had listened to my teacher's advice

warm.s: Had we known that the road was closed because of the floods, we would have taken the train instead of driving.
e: Đảo ngữ trang trọng: Had we known = If we had known. Mệnh đề chính loại 3: would have taken.
Formal inversion: Had we known = If we had known. Third-conditional main clause: would have taken.

warm.s: If my parents hadn't encouraged me to read so much as a child, I wouldn't be working as an editor today.
e: Nhấn vào hadn't và wouldn't; đọc nối “wouldn't be” và nhấn mạnh “today” để làm rõ kết quả ở hiện tại.
Stress hadn't and wouldn't; link “wouldn't be” and stress “today” to show the present result.

rd2.tx: Ten years ago, Tuan missed a flight that probably changed his life. He had overslept after a late night, and by the time he reached Tan Son Nhat airport, the gate had closed. If he had caught that plane, he would have started a job at a bank in Singapore the following Monday. Instead, he spent the afternoon in a café, where he got talking to a woman who was looking for someone to help her open a small bakery. “If I hadn't been so angry with myself, I would never have started a conversation with a stranger,” he says now, laughing. The woman, Hanh, later became his business partner, and today they own six bakeries in Ho Chi Minh City. Tuan admits that he sometimes wonders about the other path. If he had moved to Singapore, he might be richer now, but he doubts he would be happier. “Had I been on time that morning,” he says, “I would be sitting in an office tower, looking at spreadsheets instead of bread.”
rd2.tr: Mười năm trước, Tuấn lỡ một chuyến bay mà có lẽ đã thay đổi cuộc đời anh. Anh ngủ quên sau một đêm thức khuya, và khi đến sân bay Tân Sơn Nhất thì cửa ra máy bay đã đóng. Nếu bắt kịp chuyến bay đó, anh đã bắt đầu làm ở một ngân hàng tại Singapore vào thứ Hai tuần sau. Thay vào đó, anh ngồi cả buổi chiều trong một quán cà phê, nơi anh bắt chuyện với một phụ nữ đang tìm người giúp mở một tiệm bánh nhỏ. “Nếu lúc đó tôi không tức giận với bản thân đến thế, tôi đã chẳng bao giờ bắt chuyện với người lạ,” giờ anh vừa cười vừa kể. Người phụ nữ ấy, chị Hạnh, sau này trở thành đối tác kinh doanh của anh, và hôm nay họ có sáu tiệm bánh ở TP. Hồ Chí Minh. Tuấn thừa nhận đôi khi anh vẫn nghĩ về con đường kia. Nếu đã chuyển sang Singapore, có thể bây giờ anh giàu hơn, nhưng anh không chắc mình sẽ hạnh phúc hơn. “Nếu sáng hôm đó tôi đến đúng giờ,” anh nói, “thì giờ tôi đang ngồi trong một tòa văn phòng, nhìn bảng tính thay vì nhìn bánh mì.”

q: Vì sao Tuấn lỡ chuyến bay?
Why did Tuan miss the flight?
o: Anh ngủ quên sau một đêm thức khuya
He overslept after a late night
Anh mải nói chuyện ở quán cà phê
He was talking in a café
e: “He had overslept after a late night” – quá khứ hoàn thành cho việc xảy ra trước khi anh đến sân bay. Cuộc nói chuyện ở quán cà phê xảy ra sau khi đã lỡ chuyến.
“He had overslept after a late night” – the past perfect shows this happened before he reached the airport. The café conversation came after he missed the flight.
f: He had overslept after a late night

q: Nếu bắt kịp chuyến bay, điều gì đã xảy ra?
What would have happened if he had caught the plane?
o: Anh đã bắt đầu làm ở ngân hàng tại Singapore
He would have started a bank job in Singapore
Anh đã mở tiệm bánh ở Singapore
He would have opened a bakery in Singapore
Anh đã gặp chị Hạnh trên máy bay
He would have met Hanh on the plane
e: Câu loại 3: “If he had caught that plane, he would have started a job at a bank in Singapore”. Thực tế anh không đi, nên điều này không xảy ra.
Third conditional: “If he had caught that plane, he would have started a job at a bank in Singapore”. In reality he didn't go, so it never happened.
f: he would have started a job at a bank in Singapore

q: Tuấn nghĩ gì về “con đường kia”?
What does Tuan think about “the other path”?
o: Có thể giàu hơn nhưng chưa chắc hạnh phúc hơn
He might be richer but probably not happier
Anh rất hối hận vì đã lỡ chuyến bay
He deeply regrets missing the flight
Anh chắc chắn sẽ nghèo hơn
He is sure he would be poorer
e: Câu hỗn hợp “If he had moved…, he might be richer now” + “he doubts he would be happier” → anh không hối tiếc nhiều. Anh còn cười khi kể chuyện.
The mixed conditional “If he had moved…, he might be richer now” + “he doubts he would be happier” → he doesn't really regret it. He even laughs about it.
f: he might be richer now, but he doubts he would be happier

ex2.s: If the government had invested more in public transport twenty years ago, the traffic in our cities ___ so terrible today.
e: Nguyên nhân ở quá khứ (twenty years ago) nhưng kết quả ở hiện tại (today) → câu hỗn hợp: would + V (wouldn't be). “wouldn't have been” chỉ kết quả trong quá khứ.
The cause is past (twenty years ago) but the result is present (today) → mixed conditional: would + V (wouldn't be). “wouldn't have been” would describe a past result.

ex2.s: If you ___ (tell) me that the meeting had been cancelled, I wouldn't have driven all the way across the city in the rain.
a: had told
'd told
e: Loại 3 cần If + had + V3: had told. Bẫy: “would have told” không bao giờ đứng trong mệnh đề if.
The third conditional needs If + had + past participle: had told. Trap: “would have told” never goes in the if-clause.

ex2.s: If she would have checked her email more carefully, she would have noticed that the interview had been moved to Thursday morning.
a: If she had checked her email more carefully, she would have noticed that the interview had been moved to Thursday morning.
e: Mệnh đề if của loại 3 dùng quá khứ hoàn thành (had checked), không dùng would have. Would have chỉ nằm ở mệnh đề kết quả.
The if-clause of a third conditional uses the past perfect (had checked), not would have. Would have belongs only in the result clause.

q: Viết lại thành câu điều kiện loại 3 bắt đầu bằng “If…”
Rewrite as a third conditional starting with “If…”
ex2.s: We didn't bring an umbrella, so we got completely soaked on the way back from the night market.
a: If we had brought an umbrella, we wouldn't have got completely soaked on the way back from the night market.
If we had brought an umbrella, we would not have got completely soaked on the way back from the night market.
If we had brought an umbrella, we wouldn't have gotten completely soaked on the way back from the night market.
If we'd brought an umbrella, we wouldn't have got completely soaked on the way back from the night market.
e: Đảo nghĩa thực tế: didn't bring → had brought; got soaked → wouldn't have got soaked. Loại 3 luôn nói ngược với điều đã xảy ra.
Reverse the real facts: didn't bring → had brought; got soaked → wouldn't have got soaked. The third conditional always contradicts what happened.
f: If we had brought an umbrella

ex2.s: Nếu hồi đó tôi không chuyển ra Hà Nội, có lẽ bây giờ tôi vẫn đang làm ở cửa hàng của bố mẹ dưới quê.
a: If I hadn't moved to Hanoi back then, I would probably still be working in my parents' shop in my hometown now.
If I had not moved to Hanoi at that time, I would probably still be working in my parents' shop in my home town.
If I hadn't moved to Hanoi back then, I might still be working at my parents' shop in my hometown now.
If I hadn't moved to Hanoi back then, I'd probably still be working in my parents' shop in my hometown now.
e: Quá khứ (hồi đó) → hiện tại (bây giờ): câu hỗn hợp If + had + V3, would + be + V-ing. “vẫn đang làm” → would still be working, không dùng would have worked.
Past (back then) → present (now): a mixed conditional, If + had + past participle, would + be + -ing. “still working” → would still be working, not would have worked.
f: I would probably still be working

ex2.s: Had I known|that you|were vegetarian,|I would have cooked|something different|instead of|the beef noodle soup.
m: Nếu biết bạn ăn chay thì tôi đã nấu món khác thay vì phở bò.
Had I known that you were vegetarian, I would have cooked something different instead of the beef noodle soup.
e: Đảo ngữ Had I known = If I had known (trang trọng hơn, bỏ if). Mệnh đề chính loại 3: would have cooked.
Inversion Had I known = If I had known (more formal, no if). Third-conditional main clause: would have cooked.

th:
Khi động từ tường thuật ở quá khứ, **lùi thì**:
• am / is → was; present simple → past simple
• will → would; can → could
• past simple / present perfect → past perfect

When the reporting verb is past, **backshift**:
• am / is → was; present simple → past simple
• will → would; can → could
• past simple / present perfect → past perfect
Đổi trạng từ: today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before, here → there, now → then, this → that.
Change time and place words: today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, yesterday → the day before, here → there, now → then, this → that.
**say** (something) / **tell + người**: She said (that)… / She told me (that)…
**say** (something) / **tell + person**: She said (that)… / She told me (that)…
Câu hỏi tường thuật dùng **trật tự câu khẳng định**, câu Yes/No dùng **if / whether**: He asked where I lived. She asked if I was hungry.
Reported questions use **statement word order**; yes/no questions use **if / whether**: He asked where I lived. She asked if I was hungry.
vo: to say something is not true
ex: “I am tired.” → She said she ___ tired.
“I will call you.” → He said he ___ call me.
She ___ me that she was moving to Hue.
“Where do you live?” → He asked me…
“Where do you live?” → He asked me…
“Are you hungry?” → She asked ___ I was hungry.
“I'll see you tomorrow.” → He said he would see me ___ .
She told me that she had lost her keys
Cô ấy nói với tôi rằng cô ấy đã làm mất chìa khóa.
He asked whether I had finished the report.

warm.s: My manager told me that she would be away for the rest of the week and asked whether I could lead the Friday meeting.
q: Quản lý đã hỏi điều gì?
What did the manager ask?
o: Người nói có thể chủ trì cuộc họp thứ Sáu không
Whether the speaker could lead the Friday meeting
Người nói có đi vắng không
Whether the speaker would be away
Vì sao cuộc họp bị hủy
Why the meeting had been cancelled
e: Câu hỏi Yes/No tường thuật dùng whether/if + trật tự câu khẳng định: “asked whether I could lead…”. Người đi vắng là quản lý, không phải người nói.
A reported yes/no question uses whether/if + statement order: “asked whether I could lead…”. It is the manager, not the speaker, who will be away.
f: asked whether I could lead the Friday meeting

warm.s: The doctor explained that I had been working too hard and suggested that I take a few days off to rest.
e: Lùi thì: have been working → had been working. Sau suggest that dùng động từ nguyên mẫu: take.
Backshift: have been working → had been working. After suggest that, use the base form: take.

warm.s: When I asked the receptionist where the conference room was, she said it was on the fourth floor next to the lifts.
e: Trong câu hỏi tường thuật, “was” đứng cuối mệnh đề, không đảo lên trước. Đọc rõ âm /θ/ trong fourth.
In the reported question, “was” goes at the end of the clause, not before the subject. Pronounce the /θ/ in fourth clearly.

rd2.tx:
Hi Phuong,
I'm sorry you couldn't come to the meeting yesterday, so here is a quick summary. Mr Dung said that the company had lost two important clients in the last quarter and that sales would probably fall again in the spring. He told us that there would be no new hiring until the end of the year. Linh asked whether the marketing budget would also be cut, and he admitted that he hadn't decided yet. Then the head of IT announced that the new software was going to be installed the following week, and she warned us that the system might be slow for a few days. Finally, Mr Dung asked everyone to send him ideas for reducing costs by Friday. He also mentioned that he wanted to speak to you personally, so you should probably call him today. Let me know if you have any questions.
Best,
Hoa
rd2.tr:
Chào Phương,
Tiếc là hôm qua bạn không dự họp được, nên mình tóm tắt nhanh nhé. Anh Dũng nói công ty đã mất hai khách hàng quan trọng trong quý vừa rồi và doanh số có lẽ sẽ lại giảm vào mùa xuân. Anh ấy bảo sẽ không tuyển thêm người cho đến cuối năm. Linh hỏi ngân sách marketing có bị cắt luôn không, và anh ấy thừa nhận là mình chưa quyết. Sau đó trưởng phòng IT thông báo phần mềm mới sẽ được cài đặt vào tuần sau, và chị ấy cảnh báo hệ thống có thể chạy chậm vài ngày. Cuối cùng, anh Dũng yêu cầu mọi người gửi ý tưởng cắt giảm chi phí trước thứ Sáu. Anh ấy cũng nhắc là muốn nói chuyện riêng với bạn, nên chắc bạn nên gọi cho anh ấy hôm nay. Có gì thắc mắc thì báo mình nhé.
Thân,
Hoa

q: Anh Dũng nói gì về việc tuyển dụng?
What did Mr Dung say about hiring?
o: Sẽ không tuyển mới đến cuối năm
There would be no new hiring until the end of the year
Sẽ tuyển thêm vào mùa xuân
There would be more hiring in the spring
Phòng IT sẽ tuyển thêm người
The IT department would hire more staff
e: “He told us that there would be no new hiring until the end of the year” – will be đã lùi thành would be trong câu tường thuật.
“He told us that there would be no new hiring until the end of the year” – will be has been backshifted to would be.
f: there would be no new hiring until the end of the year

q: Linh đã hỏi điều gì?
What did Linh ask?
o: Ngân sách marketing có bị cắt không
Whether the marketing budget would be cut
Khi nào phần mềm mới được cài
When the new software would be installed
Vì sao công ty mất khách hàng
Why the company had lost clients
e: “Linh asked whether the marketing budget would also be cut” – câu hỏi Yes/No tường thuật với whether. Câu về phần mềm là lời thông báo của trưởng phòng IT.
“Linh asked whether the marketing budget would also be cut” – a reported yes/no question with whether. The software information was announced by the head of IT.
f: Linh asked whether the marketing budget would also be cut

q: Theo Hoa, Phương có lẽ nên làm gì?
According to Hoa, what should Phuong probably do?
o: Gọi cho anh Dũng ngay hôm nay
Gửi biên bản họp cho Linh
e: “He also mentioned that he wanted to speak to you personally, so you should probably call him today.” mention + that-clause cũng lùi thì: wants → wanted.
“He also mentioned that he wanted to speak to you personally, so you should probably call him today.” mention + that-clause is also backshifted: wants → wanted.
f: so you should probably call him today

ex2.s: When I met my old teacher at the station last week, she ___ me that she had retired and moved back to her hometown in Nam Dinh.
e: Có tân ngữ chỉ người ngay sau động từ (me) → dùng told. Không nói “said me” (phải là said to me); spoke không đi với that-clause.
A personal object follows the verb (me) → use told. You can't say “said me” (it would be said to me), and spoke doesn't take a that-clause.

ex2.s: The interviewer asked me ___ I had ever worked in a team with people from different countries before applying for this job.
a: if
whether
e: Câu hỏi gốc là Yes/No (“Have you ever worked…?”) nên khi tường thuật cần if hoặc whether. Không dùng that.
The original is a yes/no question (“Have you ever worked…?”), so reported speech needs if or whether. Don't use that.

ex2.s: The tourist asked me where was the nearest pharmacy, because her son had a high fever and needed some medicine immediately.
a: The tourist asked me where the nearest pharmacy was, because her son had a high fever and needed some medicine immediately.
e: Câu hỏi tường thuật dùng trật tự câu khẳng định: where + chủ ngữ + động từ (where the nearest pharmacy was). Không đảo động từ lên trước chủ ngữ như câu hỏi trực tiếp.
Reported questions use statement word order: where + subject + verb (where the nearest pharmacy was). Don't invert as in a direct question.

q: Chuyển sang câu tường thuật, bắt đầu bằng “She said…”
Report the sentence, starting with “She said…”
ex2.s: “I will send you the final version of the report tomorrow, after I have checked the figures again,” my colleague said.
a: She said she would send me the final version of the report the next day, after she had checked the figures again.
She said that she would send me the final version of the report the next day, after she had checked the figures again.
She said she would send me the final version of the report the following day, after she had checked the figures again.
She said that she would send me the final version of the report the following day, after she had checked the figures again.
e: Ba thay đổi: will → would, have checked → had checked, tomorrow → the next day / the following day. Đại từ cũng đổi: I → she, you → me.
Three changes: will → would, have checked → had checked, tomorrow → the next day / the following day. Pronouns change too: I → she, you → me.

ex2.s: Anh ấy hỏi tôi đã sống ở thành phố này bao lâu rồi và tôi có định ở lại sau khi tốt nghiệp không.
a: He asked me how long I had lived in the city and whether I was planning to stay after graduating.
He asked me how long I had been living in the city and whether I planned to stay after I graduated.
He asked me how long I had lived in that city and if I was planning to stay after graduation.
He asked me how long I had been living in this city and whether I was planning to stay after graduating.
e: Hai câu hỏi tường thuật: câu hỏi Wh- giữ từ để hỏi (how long I had lived), câu Yes/No dùng whether/if. Cả hai đều lùi thì và giữ trật tự câu khẳng định.
Two reported questions: the wh-question keeps its question word (how long I had lived); the yes/no question uses whether/if. Both are backshifted with statement word order.

ex2.s: She admitted|that she|had forgotten|to lock the door|before leaving|for the airport|the day before.
m: Cô ấy thừa nhận đã quên khóa cửa trước khi ra sân bay hôm trước.
She admitted that she had forgotten to lock the door before leaving for the airport the day before.
e: admit + that + quá khứ hoàn thành (had forgotten) vì việc quên xảy ra trước lúc thừa nhận. “yesterday” đổi thành “the day before”.
admit + that + past perfect (had forgotten) because forgetting happened before admitting. “yesterday” becomes “the day before”.

t: Động từ khuyết thiếu suy luận
th:
Suy luận ở hiện tại:
• **must** – chắc chắn đúng: She must be at home – the lights are on.
• **might / may / could** – có thể
• **can't** – chắc chắn không: It can't be true!

Present deduction:
• **must** – almost certain: She must be at home – the lights are on.
• **might / may / could** – possible
• **can't** – certainly not: It can't be true!
Suy luận về quá khứ: **must have + V3**, **might / may / could have + V3**, **can't / couldn't have + V3**. He must have forgotten. They can't have finished already.
Past deduction: **must have + V3**, **might / may / could have + V3**, **can't / couldn't have + V3**. He must have forgotten. They can't have finished already.
Phủ định của must (suy luận) là **can't**, không phải mustn't (mustn't = cấm).
The negative of deductive must is **can't**, not mustn't (mustn't = prohibition).
**should have + V3**: lẽ ra nên (tiếc nuối, trách móc): You should have told me.
**should have + V3**: criticism or regret: You should have told me.
vo: facts that show something is true
to reach a conclusion from evidence
ex: He's been working for 14 hours. He ___ be exhausted.
That ___ be Tom – he's in Paris this week.
She didn't answer. She ___ have been asleep.
The window is broken. Someone ___ have thrown a stone.
You ___ have told me earlier! Now it's too late.
Phủ định của “must be” (suy luận) là?
The negative of deductive “must be” is?
They can't have finished the project already
Chắc chắn họ chưa thể xong dự án được.
She must have missed the bus.

warm.s: The lights are off and nobody is answering the phone, so they must have gone out for dinner, or they might be asleep already.
q: Người nói nghĩ gì?
What does the speaker think?
o: Họ đã ra ngoài ăn tối hoặc đã ngủ
They have gone out or are already asleep
Họ chắc chắn đang ở nhà
Họ không thể đã ra ngoài
e: must have gone out = gần như chắc chắn đã đi (quá khứ); might be asleep = có thể đang ngủ (hiện tại). Cả hai đều là suy đoán dựa trên bằng chứng: đèn tắt, không ai nghe máy.
must have gone out = almost certainly went out (past); might be asleep = possibly sleeping (present). Both are deductions from the evidence: lights off, no answer.
f: they must have gone out for dinner

warm.s: He can't have read the whole report this morning, because it is over two hundred pages long and full of tables.
e: can't have + V3: chắc chắn đã không. V3 của read vẫn viết là read (đọc /red/).
can't have + past participle: certainly didn't. The past participle of read is spelled read (pronounced /red/).

warm.s: You should have told me you were feeling ill, because I could have taken you to the doctor before the clinic closed.
e: Trong văn nói, “should have” đọc lướt thành /ˈʃʊd.əv/ và “could have” thành /ˈkʊd.əv/; nhấn vào told và taken.
In speech “should have” reduces to /ˈʃʊd.əv/ and “could have” to /ˈkʊd.əv/; stress told and taken.

rd2.tx: When Mrs Lan came home on Saturday evening, she found her front door open and her living room in a mess. Cushions had been pulled off the sofa and a vase lay broken on the floor. Her first thought was that someone must have broken in. However, nothing seemed to be missing: her laptop was still on the table and her purse was in the drawer. “It can't have been a burglar,” she told her son on the phone. “A burglar would have taken the laptop.” Then she noticed muddy paw prints on the carpet and a half-eaten loaf of bread under the table. The neighbours' dog, which often escaped from their garden, might have pushed the door open. Her son suggested that she might simply have forgotten to lock it in the morning, since she had been in a hurry. Mrs Lan admitted that this could be true, but she still blamed the dog.
rd2.tr: Khi bà Lan về nhà vào tối thứ Bảy, bà thấy cửa trước mở toang và phòng khách bừa bộn. Gối bị kéo khỏi ghế sofa và một chiếc bình vỡ nằm trên sàn. Ý nghĩ đầu tiên của bà là chắc hẳn có kẻ đột nhập. Tuy nhiên, có vẻ không mất thứ gì: máy tính xách tay vẫn trên bàn và ví vẫn trong ngăn kéo. “Không thể là trộm được,” bà nói với con trai qua điện thoại. “Trộm thì đã lấy cái máy tính rồi.” Rồi bà để ý thấy dấu chân chó dính bùn trên thảm và nửa ổ bánh mì bị ăn dở dưới gầm bàn. Con chó nhà hàng xóm, vốn hay trốn khỏi vườn, có thể đã đẩy cửa vào. Con trai bà cho rằng có lẽ đơn giản là bà quên khóa cửa từ sáng, vì lúc đó bà đang vội. Bà Lan thừa nhận điều đó cũng có thể đúng, nhưng bà vẫn đổ lỗi cho con chó.

q: Vì sao bà Lan kết luận đó không thể là trộm?
Why does Mrs Lan decide it can't have been a burglar?
o: Vì máy tính và ví vẫn còn
Because her laptop and purse were still there
Because the door was still locked
Vì con trai bà nói vậy
Because her son told her so
e: “nothing seemed to be missing: her laptop was still on the table…” → “It can't have been a burglar” (can't have been = chắc chắn không phải). Cửa thì lại đang mở.
“nothing seemed to be missing: her laptop was still on the table…” → “It can't have been a burglar” (can't have been = certainly wasn't). The door was actually open.
f: It can't have been a burglar

q: Bằng chứng nào cho thấy con chó có liên quan?
What evidence points to the dog?
o: Dấu chân dính bùn và bánh mì ăn dở
Muddy paw prints and half-eaten bread
e: “muddy paw prints on the carpet and a half-eaten loaf of bread” – từ đó bà suy ra con chó “might have pushed the door open”. Bình vỡ và gối không trực tiếp chỉ ra ai làm.
“muddy paw prints on the carpet and a half-eaten loaf of bread” – from these she deduces the dog “might have pushed the door open”. The vase and cushions don't point to anyone.
f: muddy paw prints on the carpet

q: Con trai bà Lan đưa ra khả năng nào?
What possibility does Mrs Lan's son suggest?
o: Có thể bà quên khóa cửa từ sáng
She might have forgotten to lock the door
It must have been a burglar
e: “she might simply have forgotten to lock it in the morning” – might have + V3 diễn tả một khả năng trong quá khứ, không chắc chắn.
“she might simply have forgotten to lock it in the morning” – might have + past participle expresses a past possibility, not a certainty.
f: she might simply have forgotten to lock it

ex2.s: Nam has been coughing all week and he looks very pale today, so he ___ be coming down with the flu that is going round the office.
e: Bằng chứng mạnh (ho cả tuần, xanh xao) → must be: gần như chắc chắn. Bẫy: mustn't là “cấm”, không phải phủ định của suy luận.
Strong evidence (coughing all week, pale) → must be: almost certain. Trap: mustn't means prohibition, not the negative of a deduction.

ex2.s: She ___ have read my message yet, because her phone has been switched off during the whole flight from Hanoi to Tokyo.
a: can't
cannot
couldn't
e: Điện thoại tắt suốt chuyến bay → chắc chắn chưa đọc: can't have + V3. Không dùng mustn't have; might not have thì quá yếu so với bằng chứng.
Her phone was off the whole flight → she certainly hasn't read it: can't have + past participle. Don't use mustn't have; might not have is too weak for this evidence.

ex2.s: Minh mustn't be at home right now, because his motorbike isn't parked outside and all the windows are closed.
a: Minh can't be at home right now, because his motorbike isn't parked outside and all the windows are closed.
Minh cannot be at home right now, because his motorbike isn't parked outside and all the windows are closed.
Minh couldn't be at home right now, because his motorbike isn't parked outside and all the windows are closed.
e: Suy luận phủ định chắc chắn dùng can't, không dùng mustn't (mustn't = không được phép). Đây là lỗi rất phổ biến vì nghĩ “must” phủ định thành “mustn't”.
A certain negative deduction uses can't, not mustn't (mustn't = not allowed). It's a very common mistake to treat mustn't as the opposite of deductive must.

q: Viết lại câu dùng “must have + V3”
Rewrite the sentence using “must have + past participle”
ex2.s: I'm sure that the children ate all the cakes while we were out, because there are crumbs all over the kitchen floor.
a: The children must have eaten all the cakes while we were out, because there are crumbs all over the kitchen floor.
e: “I'm sure … ate” (chắc chắn về quá khứ) → must have eaten. Không viết “must ate” hay “must have ate”: sau have phải là V3 eaten.
“I'm sure … ate” (certain about the past) → must have eaten. Not “must ate” or “must have ate”: have needs the past participle eaten.

ex2.s: Có lẽ họ đã lỡ chuyến tàu cuối cùng từ Hải Phòng, vì nếu không thì giờ này họ đã về đến nhà rồi.
a: They might have missed the last train from Hai Phong, because otherwise they would have got home by now.
They may have missed the last train from Hai Phong, because otherwise they would have arrived home by now.
They could have missed the last train from Hai Phong, because otherwise they would be home by now.
They must have missed the last train from Hai Phong, because otherwise they would have got home by now.
e: “Có lẽ đã” → might / may / could have + V3 (missed). “nếu không thì … đã về rồi” → otherwise they would have got home by now.
“Probably/possibly did” → might / may / could have + past participle (missed). “otherwise … would already be home” → otherwise they would have got home by now.

ex2.s: Somebody|must have taken|my umbrella|by mistake,|because it was here|when I arrived|at the office|this morning.
m: Chắc ai đó đã cầm nhầm ô của tôi, vì lúc sáng tôi đến văn phòng nó vẫn còn ở đây.
Somebody must have taken my umbrella by mistake, because it was here when I arrived at the office this morning.
e: must have taken: kết luận gần như chắc chắn về quá khứ, dựa trên bằng chứng ở mệnh đề because.
must have taken: an almost certain conclusion about the past, based on the evidence in the because-clause.

th:
**Cấu trúc một email trang trọng**:
• Lời chào: **Dear Mr / Ms + họ** (biết tên) hoặc **Dear Sir or Madam** (không biết tên)
• Câu mở đầu nêu mục đích: **I am writing to apply for / to enquire about / to complain about…**
• Thân thư: mỗi đoạn một ý, không viết tắt (I am, không phải I'm)
• Kết thư: **I look forward to hearing from you.** + **Yours sincerely** (biết tên) / **Yours faithfully** (Dear Sir or Madam) / **Kind regards** (bán trang trọng)

**Structure of a formal email**:
• Greeting: **Dear Mr / Ms + surname** (name known) or **Dear Sir or Madam** (name unknown)
• Opening line states the purpose: **I am writing to apply for / to enquire about / to complain about…**
• Body: one idea per paragraph, no contractions (I am, not I'm)
• Closing: **I look forward to hearing from you.** + **Yours sincerely** (name known) / **Yours faithfully** (Dear Sir or Madam) / **Kind regards** (semi-formal)

**Yêu cầu lịch sự** – càng gián tiếp càng lịch sự:
• Could you send me…? → **Could you possibly** send me…?
• **I would be grateful if you could** + V
• **I was wondering if / whether you could** + V
• **Would it be possible to** reschedule the meeting?
Đính kèm tài liệu: **Please find attached** my CV. Mời liên hệ: **Please do not hesitate to contact me** if…

**Polite requests** – the more indirect, the more polite:
• Could you send me…? → **Could you possibly** send me…?
• **I would be grateful if you could** + V
• **I was wondering if / whether you could** + V
• **Would it be possible to** reschedule the meeting?
Attachments: **Please find attached** my CV. Inviting contact: **Please do not hesitate to contact me** if…

**Phàn nàn và xin lỗi** một cách chuyên nghiệp: nêu sự việc cụ thể (ngày, mã đơn), nói rõ mong muốn, giữ giọng bình tĩnh.
• **I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with…**
• **Unfortunately, the item arrived damaged.** / **I would like to request a full refund.**
• Trả lời phàn nàn: **We sincerely apologise for any inconvenience caused.**
Tránh lối nói quá thẳng như “You must…” hay “I want…”: hãy dùng **I would appreciate it if…**

**Complaining and apologising** professionally: give specific facts (dates, order numbers), say clearly what you want and keep a calm tone.
• **I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with…**
• **Unfortunately, the item arrived damaged.** / **I would like to request a full refund.**
• Replying to a complaint: **We sincerely apologise for any inconvenience caused.**
Avoid blunt phrases like “You must…” or “I want…”: use **I would appreciate it if…**
vo: đơn ứng tuyển, hồ sơ xin việc
a formal request for a job or place
to add a file to an email
a list of topics for a meeting
the latest time to finish something
to change the time of a planned event
money paid back to a customer
trouble or difficulty caused to someone

warm.s: I'm afraid I won't be able to attend Thursday's meeting, so I was wondering if we could reschedule it for Monday morning instead.
q: Người nói muốn gì?
What does the speaker want?
o: Dời cuộc họp sang sáng thứ Hai
Move the meeting to Monday morning
e: “I was wondering if we could reschedule it for Monday morning” là lời đề nghị rất lịch sự: dời lịch, không phải hủy. “I'm afraid…” mở đầu tin không vui một cách nhẹ nhàng.
“I was wondering if we could reschedule it for Monday morning” is a very polite request to move, not cancel, the meeting. “I'm afraid…” softens the bad news.
f: I was wondering if we could reschedule it

warm.s: Please find attached my CV and a cover letter, and do not hesitate to contact me if you require any further information.
e: Hai cụm cố định của email trang trọng: Please find attached… và do not hesitate to contact me. Viết đầy đủ “do not”, không rút gọn.
Two fixed formal-email phrases: Please find attached… and do not hesitate to contact me. Write “do not” in full, without contraction.

warm.s: Unfortunately, the laptop I ordered from your website arrived with a cracked screen, so I would be grateful if you could arrange a replacement or a full refund.
q: Khách hàng yêu cầu gì?
What does the customer ask for?
o: Đổi máy mới hoặc hoàn tiền toàn bộ
A replacement or a full refund
A discount on the next order
Lời xin lỗi từ người giao hàng
An apology from the delivery driver
e: “I would be grateful if you could arrange a replacement or a full refund” – yêu cầu lịch sự với hai lựa chọn rõ ràng. Không có câu nào nhắc đến giảm giá hay người giao hàng.
“I would be grateful if you could arrange a replacement or a full refund” – a polite request with two clear options. Nothing is said about discounts or the driver.
f: I would be grateful if you could arrange

warm.s: I am writing to complain about the poor service I received at your branch on Nguyen Hue Street last Saturday afternoon.
e: Giọng bình tĩnh, rõ ràng; nhấn “complain” và “poor service”. Đọc “I am” đầy đủ để giữ sắc thái trang trọng.
Calm and clear; stress “complain” and “poor service”. Say “I am” in full to keep the formal tone.

rd2.tx:
Subject: Application for the position of Marketing Assistant

Dear Ms Nguyen,

I am writing to apply for the position of Marketing Assistant, which was advertised on your company's website on 2 November. Please find attached my CV and a portfolio of recent projects.

I graduated from university in Ho Chi Minh City in June with a degree in Marketing. During my final year, I completed a six-month internship at a travel agency, where I was responsible for managing social media accounts and writing weekly newsletters in English and Vietnamese. As a result of a campaign I designed, the number of online bookings rose by twenty per cent.

I am particularly interested in your company because of its focus on sustainable tourism, which I believe is the future of the industry. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills could contribute to your team.

I am available for an interview at any time next week, although I would be grateful if it could take place after 3 p.m. on Wednesday, as I have a language exam that morning.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Tran Minh Anh
rd2.tr:
Tiêu đề: Ứng tuyển vị trí Trợ lý Marketing

Kính gửi chị Nguyễn,

Tôi viết thư này để ứng tuyển vị trí Trợ lý Marketing được đăng trên trang web của quý công ty ngày 2 tháng 11. Kèm theo đây là CV và hồ sơ các dự án gần đây của tôi.

Tôi tốt nghiệp đại học tại TP. Hồ Chí Minh vào tháng Sáu, chuyên ngành Marketing. Trong năm cuối, tôi đã hoàn thành kỳ thực tập sáu tháng tại một công ty lữ hành, nơi tôi phụ trách quản lý các tài khoản mạng xã hội và viết bản tin hằng tuần bằng tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt. Nhờ một chiến dịch do tôi thiết kế, số lượt đặt chỗ trực tuyến đã tăng hai mươi phần trăm.

Tôi đặc biệt quan tâm đến quý công ty vì định hướng du lịch bền vững, điều mà tôi tin là tương lai của ngành. Tôi rất mong có cơ hội trao đổi về việc kỹ năng của mình có thể đóng góp thế nào cho đội ngũ.

Tôi có thể phỏng vấn vào bất kỳ lúc nào trong tuần tới, tuy nhiên tôi rất biết ơn nếu buổi phỏng vấn vào thứ Tư có thể diễn ra sau 3 giờ chiều, vì sáng hôm đó tôi có một kỳ thi ngoại ngữ.

Tôi mong sớm nhận được phản hồi từ chị.

Trân trọng,
Trần Minh Anh

q: Vị trí tuyển dụng được đăng ở đâu?
Where was the job advertised?
o: Trên trang web của công ty, ngày 2/11
On the company's website on 2 November
Trên một trang tuyển dụng của trường đại học
Trên mạng xã hội của công ty lữ hành
On the travel agency's social media
e: Câu mở đầu nêu mục đích và nguồn tin: “which was advertised on your company's website on 2 November”. Công ty lữ hành là nơi Minh Anh từng thực tập.
The opening line gives the purpose and the source: “which was advertised on your company's website on 2 November”. The travel agency is where Minh Anh did her internship.
f: which was advertised on your company's website on 2 November

q: Chiến dịch Minh Anh thiết kế mang lại kết quả gì?
What was the result of the campaign Minh Anh designed?
o: Lượt đặt chỗ trực tuyến tăng 20%
Số người theo dõi tăng gấp đôi
Công ty mở thêm văn phòng
The company opened a new office
e: “As a result of a campaign I designed, the number of online bookings rose by twenty per cent.” Nêu thành tích bằng con số cụ thể là cách viết đơn xin việc hiệu quả.
“As a result of a campaign I designed, the number of online bookings rose by twenty per cent.” Giving a concrete figure is an effective way to show achievements.
f: the number of online bookings rose by twenty per cent

q: Vì sao Minh Anh xin phỏng vấn thứ Tư sau 3 giờ chiều?
Why does Minh Anh ask for a Wednesday interview after 3 p.m.?
o: Vì sáng hôm đó cô có kỳ thi ngoại ngữ
She has a language exam that morning
Vì cô vẫn đang thực tập
She is still doing her internship
Vì công ty chỉ phỏng vấn buổi chiều
The company only interviews in the afternoon
e: “I would be grateful if it could take place after 3 p.m. on Wednesday, as I have a language exam that morning.” as = because, dùng trong văn trang trọng.
“I would be grateful if it could take place after 3 p.m. on Wednesday, as I have a language exam that morning.” as = because, common in formal writing.
f: as I have a language exam that morning

ex2.s: I would be grateful if you ___ send me the agenda for Friday's meeting at least two days in advance, so that I can prepare properly.
e: Cấu trúc cố định: I would be grateful if you could + V. Vì mệnh đề chính có would (giả định lịch sự), mệnh đề if dùng could, không dùng can hay will.
Fixed pattern: I would be grateful if you could + V. Because the main clause has would (polite hypothesis), the if-clause uses could, not can or will.
f: I would be grateful if you could

ex2.s: We sincerely apologise for any ___ caused by the delay in delivery and have added a ten per cent discount to your next order.
a: inconvenience
e: Cụm chuẩn khi xin lỗi khách hàng: apologise for any inconvenience caused. inconvenience là danh từ không đếm được nên không thêm -s.
The standard apology phrase: apologise for any inconvenience caused. inconvenience is uncountable here, so no -s.

ex2.s: I am writing for complaining about the late delivery of my order, which I placed on 3 November and which has still not arrived.
a: I am writing to complain about the late delivery of my order, which I placed on 3 November and which has still not arrived.
e: Mục đích viết thư dùng to + V: I am writing to complain / to apply / to enquire. “writing for complaining” là lỗi dịch từ “viết để phàn nàn”.
The purpose of writing uses to + infinitive: I am writing to complain / to apply / to enquire. “writing for complaining” is a translation error.

q: Viết lại cho lịch sự, trang trọng hơn, bắt đầu bằng “I was wondering if…”
Make the request more polite and formal, starting with “I was wondering if…”
ex2.s: Send me the updated sales figures before the meeting with the clients on Thursday afternoon.
a: I was wondering if you could send me the updated sales figures before the meeting with the clients on Thursday afternoon.
I was wondering whether you could send me the updated sales figures before the meeting with the clients on Thursday afternoon.
I was wondering if you could possibly send me the updated sales figures before the meeting with the clients on Thursday afternoon.
e: Câu mệnh lệnh quá thẳng với đồng nghiệp hoặc cấp trên. “I was wondering if you could + V” dùng thì quá khứ để tạo khoảng cách lịch sự, dù đang nói về hiện tại.
A bare imperative is too direct for a colleague or manager. “I was wondering if you could + V” uses the past tense to create polite distance, even though it refers to now.
f: I was wondering if you could send me

ex2.s: Tôi viết thư này để ứng tuyển vị trí trợ lý kinh doanh được đăng trên trang web của quý công ty vào tuần trước.
a: I am writing to apply for the position of sales assistant which was advertised on your company's website last week.
I am writing to apply for the position of Sales Assistant, which was advertised on your company website last week.
I am writing to apply for the sales assistant position advertised on your company's website last week.
I'm writing to apply for the position of sales assistant that was advertised on your company's website last week.
e: Mở đầu chuẩn: I am writing to apply for the position of… “quý công ty” → your company (tiếng Anh không có từ tôn xưng riêng). Có thể rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ: the position advertised on…
Standard opening: I am writing to apply for the position of… “quý công ty” is simply your company. The relative clause can be reduced: the position advertised on…
f: I am writing to apply for the position of

ex2.s: Please do not hesitate|to contact me|if you have|any further questions|about the proposal|that I sent you|last Monday.
m: Xin đừng ngần ngại liên hệ với tôi nếu anh/chị có thêm câu hỏi nào về bản đề xuất tôi gửi hôm thứ Hai tuần trước.
Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have any further questions about the proposal that I sent you last Monday.
e: Câu kết quen thuộc của email trang trọng: Please do not hesitate to contact me if… Mệnh đề quan hệ “that I sent you last Monday” xác định bản đề xuất nào.
A common formal closing: Please do not hesitate to contact me if… The relative clause “that I sent you last Monday” identifies which proposal.
f: Please do not hesitate to contact me

th:
**Ngữ pháp 1 – câu bị động:** be + V3 khi hành động quan trọng hơn người làm. Hiện tại: **is/are + V3**; quá khứ: **was/were + V3**; hiện tại hoàn thành: **has/have been + V3**; với động từ khuyết thiếu: **should/can/must be + V3**. Người làm (nếu cần) dùng **by**.
• Plastic bottles are recycled in this factory.
• Millions of trees are cut down every year.
• Waste should be sorted before it is collected.

**Grammar 1 – the passive:** be + past participle when the action matters more than who does it. Present: **is/are + V3**; past: **was/were + V3**; present perfect: **has/have been + V3**; with modals: **should/can/must be + V3**. Add the doer with **by** if needed.
• Plastic bottles are recycled in this factory.
• Millions of trees are cut down every year.
• Waste should be sorted before it is collected.

**Ngữ pháp 2 – nối nguyên nhân & kết quả:** **because of + danh từ** (because of the pollution); **because + mệnh đề**; **as a result** / **therefore** đứng đầu câu kết quả, sau đó có dấu phẩy.
• Because of the pollution, many people wear masks.
• The river is polluted. As a result, the fish have died.
• Sea levels are rising; therefore, coastal cities face more floods.

**Grammar 2 – linking causes & results:** **because of + noun** (because of the pollution); **because + clause**; **as a result** / **therefore** start the result sentence, followed by a comma.
• Because of the pollution, many people wear masks.
• The river is polluted. As a result, the fish have died.
• Sea levels are rising; therefore, coastal cities face more floods.

**Phát âm – âm /ə/ không nhấn:** trong từ dài, âm tiết không nhấn thường đọc thành /ə/ rất nhẹ: pollution /pəˈluː.ʃən/, environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/, renewable /rɪˈnuː.ə.bəl/, government /ˈɡʌv.ɚn.mənt/. Nhấn rõ một âm tiết, các âm còn lại đọc lướt.

**Pronunciation – unstressed /ə/:** in long words the unstressed syllables are often a very light /ə/: pollution /pəˈluː.ʃən/, environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/, renewable /rɪˈnuː.ə.bəl/, government /ˈɡʌv.ɚn.mənt/. Stress one syllable clearly and reduce the rest.

**Tự luyện ngoài app:**
• Nghe (25 phút): nghe 1 bản tin môi trường 3–5 phút, ghi nguyên nhân, hậu quả, giải pháp.
• Nói (25 phút): nói 2 phút “3 things everyone can do to protect the environment”, dùng câu bị động ít nhất 2 lần.
• Đọc (25 phút): đọc 1 bài báo về biến đổi khí hậu, tìm 5 số liệu và giải thích ý nghĩa.
• Viết (40 phút): viết bài luận 200 từ dạng vấn đề – giải pháp về rác thải nhựa.
• Từ vựng (15 phút): bảng 3 cột nguyên nhân – hậu quả – giải pháp, mỗi cột 5 cụm từ.
• Thử thách (7 ngày): mỗi ngày ghi 2 câu nhật ký rác thải nhựa của bản thân, cuối tuần viết 1 câu kết luận.

**Practice outside the app:**
• Listening (25 min): listen to a 3–5-minute environment news report; note causes, effects and solutions.
• Speaking (25 min): talk for 2 minutes on “3 things everyone can do to protect the environment”, using the passive at least twice.
• Reading (25 min): read an article on climate change; find 5 figures and explain what each means.
• Writing (40 min): write a 200-word problem–solution essay about plastic waste.
• Vocabulary (15 min): make a 3-column table – causes, effects, solutions – with 5 phrases each.
• Challenge (7 days): keep a plastic-waste diary of 2 sentences a day and write a one-sentence conclusion at the weekend.

warm.s: Because of the heavy rain last week, several villages in the central provinces were flooded and hundreds of families were moved to safer areas.
q: Điều gì đã xảy ra với các gia đình?
What happened to the families?
o: Họ được đưa đến nơi an toàn hơn
They were moved to safer areas
e: Câu bị động quá khứ: “hundreds of families were moved to safer areas”. Nguyên nhân: “Because of the heavy rain”.
Past passive: “hundreds of families were moved to safer areas”. The cause: “Because of the heavy rain”.

warm.s: Air pollution is getting worse and worse.
e: “worse and worse” = ngày càng tệ hơn (so sánh kép). bad → worse.
“worse and worse” = continually worse (double comparative). bad → worse.

warm.s: We should use fewer plastic bags.
e: “bags” đếm được → fewer (không dùng less).
“bags” is countable → fewer (not less).

warm.s: Waste is sorted before it is recycled.
e: Hai động từ đều ở bị động hiện tại: is sorted, is recycled.
Both verbs are present passive: is sorted, is recycled.
f: is sorted before it is recycled

warm.s: If we don't act now, the consequences will be serious.
e: Câu điều kiện loại 1: If + hiện tại (don't act), will + V (will be).
First conditional: If + present (don't act), will + verb (will be).

warm.s: I think the biggest environmental problem in my city is air pollution, which is mainly caused by millions of motorbikes and the construction of new buildings.
e: Câu hỏi: What is the biggest environmental problem in your city? – Gợi ý trả lời mẫu. “environmental” nhấn /ɪnˌvaɪ.rənˈmen.t̬əl/; bị động “is mainly caused by”.
Question: What is the biggest environmental problem in your city? – Model answer. Stress en-vi-ron-MEN-tal; note the passive “is mainly caused by”.

rd2.tx: Every year, around 400 million tonnes of plastic are produced around the world, and about half of it is designed to be used only once. Only a small part of this plastic is recycled. The rest is burned, buried in landfill or washed into rivers and oceans. As a result, sea birds and turtles often die after they mistake plastic bags for food. Some reports have even warned that by 2050 the oceans could contain more plastic than fish by weight. In Vietnam, the problem is getting worse because of fast economic growth and the popularity of takeaway food and drinks. However, things are beginning to change. In several cities, plastic straws have been replaced by paper or bamboo ones, and some supermarkets now wrap vegetables in banana leaves. Experts believe that single-use plastic should be banned completely, but they also say that individuals can make a difference. Therefore, next time you buy a coffee, bring your own cup.
rd2.tr: Mỗi năm, khoảng 400 triệu tấn nhựa được sản xuất trên khắp thế giới, và khoảng một nửa trong số đó được thiết kế để chỉ dùng một lần. Chỉ một phần nhỏ lượng nhựa này được tái chế. Phần còn lại bị đốt, chôn ở bãi rác hoặc bị cuốn trôi xuống sông và đại dương. Hậu quả là chim biển và rùa thường chết sau khi nhầm túi nhựa là thức ăn. Một số báo cáo thậm chí còn cảnh báo rằng đến năm 2050, tính theo khối lượng, đại dương có thể chứa nhiều nhựa hơn cá. Ở Việt Nam, vấn đề ngày càng nghiêm trọng vì kinh tế tăng trưởng nhanh và sự phổ biến của đồ ăn, đồ uống mang đi. Tuy nhiên, mọi thứ đang bắt đầu thay đổi. Ở một số thành phố, ống hút nhựa đã được thay bằng ống hút giấy hoặc tre, và một số siêu thị giờ gói rau bằng lá chuối. Các chuyên gia tin rằng nhựa dùng một lần nên bị cấm hoàn toàn, nhưng họ cũng nói rằng mỗi cá nhân có thể tạo ra sự khác biệt. Vì vậy, lần tới khi mua cà phê, hãy mang theo cốc của riêng bạn.

q: Bao nhiêu phần nhựa được thiết kế để dùng một lần?
How much of the plastic is designed to be used only once?
e: “about half of it is designed to be used only once”. “Only a small part” là phần được tái chế.
“about half of it is designed to be used only once”. “Only a small part” is the amount recycled.
f: about half of it is designed to be used only once

q: Theo bài, vì sao vấn đề ở Việt Nam ngày càng tệ?
According to the text, why is the problem getting worse in Vietnam?
o: Fast economic growth and popular takeaway food and drinks
Too many sea birds and turtles
e: “because of fast economic growth and the popularity of takeaway food and drinks” – because of + cụm danh từ.
“because of fast economic growth and the popularity of takeaway food and drinks” – because of + noun phrase.

q: Điều gì đã thay đổi ở một số thành phố?
What has changed in several cities?
o: Plastic straws have been replaced by paper or bamboo ones.
Single-use plastic has been banned completely.
e: Bị động hiện tại hoàn thành: “plastic straws have been replaced by paper or bamboo ones”. Lệnh cấm hoàn toàn mới chỉ là ý kiến chuyên gia (“should be banned”).
Present perfect passive: “plastic straws have been replaced by paper or bamboo ones”. A full ban is only the experts' opinion (“should be banned”).
f: have been replaced by paper or bamboo ones

ex2.s: Plastic bottles ___ recycled in this factory, and the material is then used to make clothes and bags.
a: are
e: Bị động hiện tại: are + V3. Chủ ngữ “Plastic bottles” số nhiều → are.
Present passive: are + past participle. “Plastic bottles” is plural → are.

ex2.s: ___ of the pollution, many people in big cities wear masks when they ride their motorbikes to work.
a: Because
e: “Because of” + danh từ (the pollution). “Because” một mình phải đi với mệnh đề có động từ.
“Because of” + noun (the pollution). “Because” alone needs a clause with a verb.

ex2.s: Millions of trees ___ cut down every year to make space for farms, roads and new cities.
a: are
e: Bị động hiện tại cho sự việc lặp lại (every year): are cut down. “cut” có V3 cũng là “cut”.
Present passive for a regular event (every year): are cut down. The participle of “cut” is “cut”.

ex2.s: The old factory polluted the river for years; ___, the local government finally decided to close it down last spring.
e: Vế sau là kết quả của vế trước → “therefore” (vì vậy), có dấu phẩy sau. “because of” cần danh từ; “although” chỉ sự tương phản.
The second part is the result → “therefore”, followed by a comma. “because of” needs a noun; “although” shows contrast.

ex2.s: Thousands of tonnes of rubbish is thrown into the sea every day, and most of it never disappears.
a: Thousands of tonnes of rubbish are thrown into the sea every day, and most of it never disappears.
e: Chủ ngữ chính là “Thousands of tonnes” (số nhiều) → động từ “are thrown”.
The real subject is “Thousands of tonnes” (plural) → “are thrown”.

ex2.s: Many new solar farms have built in the south of Vietnam because the region gets a lot of sunshine all year.
a: Many new solar farms have been built in the south of Vietnam because the region gets a lot of sunshine all year.
e: Trang trại không tự xây → cần bị động hiện tại hoàn thành: have **been** built.
Farms don't build themselves → present perfect passive: have **been** built.

ex2.s: Chúng ta nên đi xe đạp thay vì đi ô tô.
a: We should cycle instead of driving.
We should ride bikes instead of driving.
We should go by bike instead of by car.
We should cycle instead of going by car.
e: Sau “instead of” dùng V-ing (driving), không dùng nguyên mẫu.
After “instead of” use the -ing form (driving), not the base verb.

ex2.s: Mùa hè năm nay nóng hơn mọi năm.
a: This summer is hotter than usual.
This summer is hotter than in previous years.
This summer has been hotter than usual.
This summer is hotter than other years.
e: “hot” → “hotter” (gấp đôi t). “mọi năm” = usual / previous years.
“hot” → “hotter” (double t). “mọi năm” = usual / previous years.

q: Viết lại câu ở thể bị động, bỏ người thực hiện.
Rewrite the sentence in the passive, without the doer.
ex2.s: The city government should ban single-use plastic bags in all markets and supermarkets by next year.
a: Single-use plastic bags should be banned in all markets and supermarkets by next year.
Single-use plastic bags should be banned in all markets and supermarkets by next year by the city government.
e: Bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu: should + be + V3 → should be banned. Tân ngữ “single-use plastic bags” lên làm chủ ngữ.
Modal passive: should + be + past participle → should be banned. The object becomes the subject.

ex2.s: Vì lượng khí thải từ nhà máy, không khí ở khu vực này đã bị ô nhiễm nặng trong nhiều năm.
a: Because of the emissions from the factories, the air in this area has been heavily polluted for many years.
Because of emissions from factories, the air in this area has been badly polluted for many years.
Because of the factory emissions, the air in this area has been seriously polluted for years.
e: “Vì + danh từ” → Because of. “đã bị … trong nhiều năm” → bị động hiện tại hoàn thành “has been polluted” + for many years.
“Because of + noun”. “has been … for many years” → present perfect passive + for.
f: has been heavily polluted for many years

ex2.s: As a result of|rising temperatures,|coastal cities|are|expected|to face|more floods|in the coming decades.
m: Do nhiệt độ tăng, các thành phố ven biển được dự báo sẽ phải đối mặt với nhiều trận lũ hơn trong những thập kỷ tới.
As a result of rising temperatures, coastal cities are expected to face more floods in the coming decades.
e: “As a result of + danh từ” chỉ nguyên nhân; bị động “are expected to + V” = được dự báo sẽ.
“As a result of + noun” gives the cause; the passive “are expected to + verb” = people predict that.

q: Viết thư khoảng 150 từ gửi chính quyền thành phố đề xuất 3 cách giảm ô nhiễm không khí.
Write a letter of about 150 words to the city government suggesting 3 ways to reduce air pollution.
ex2.m:
Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to express my concern about the level of air pollution in our city. On many days this year, the air quality has been rated “unhealthy”, and as a result, more children are being taken to hospital with breathing problems.
I would like to suggest three solutions. Firstly, public transport should be improved. If more bus lanes are built and tickets are made cheaper, fewer people will use motorbikes. Secondly, old vehicles with high emissions should be banned from the city centre. Finally, more trees should be planted along main roads and in parks, because they clean the air and make the streets cooler.
I understand that these changes cost money; however, the cost of doing nothing will be much higher. I hope that my suggestions will be considered.
Yours faithfully,
Tran Bao Ngoc
e: Cần có: • nêu vấn đề và hậu quả (as a result) • 3 đề xuất rõ ràng với Firstly / Secondly / Finally • ít nhất 3 câu bị động (should be improved…) • văn phong trang trọng: Dear Sir or Madam … Yours faithfully.

Include: • the problem and its effects (as a result) • 3 clear suggestions with Firstly / Secondly / Finally • at least 3 passive sentences (should be improved…) • formal style: Dear Sir or Madam … Yours faithfully.

th:
**Ngữ pháp 1 – câu tường thuật:** khi động từ tường thuật ở quá khứ (said, told, announced), động từ trong câu gốc thường **lùi một thì**: am/is → was, are → were, will → would, can → could, hiện tại hoàn thành → quá khứ hoàn thành. Đổi đại từ và từ chỉ thời gian (today → that day, next week → the following week).
• “Prices are rising.” → The minister said that prices were rising.
• “We will cut taxes.” → The government announced that it would cut taxes.
• “Unemployment has fallen.” → The report said that unemployment had fallen.

**Grammar 1 – reported speech:** when the reporting verb is past (said, told, announced), the original verb usually **moves back one tense**: am/is → was, are → were, will → would, can → could, present perfect → past perfect. Change pronouns and time words (today → that day, next week → the following week).
• “Prices are rising.” → The minister said that prices were rising.
• “We will cut taxes.” → The government announced that it would cut taxes.
• “Unemployment has fallen.” → The report said that unemployment had fallen.

**Ngữ pháp 2 – nói giảm nhẹ (hedging):** báo chí và bài luận tránh khẳng định tuyệt đối, dùng **it seems that**, **appear to**, **tend to**, **is likely to**, **may / might**. Lập luận hai chiều dùng **On the one hand …, on the other hand …**.
• It seems that unemployment is falling.
• Young people tend to get their news from social media.
• House prices are likely to rise again next year.

**Grammar 2 – hedging:** news and essays avoid absolute claims, using **it seems that**, **appear to**, **tend to**, **is likely to**, **may / might**. Balanced arguments use **On the one hand …, on the other hand …**.
• It seems that unemployment is falling.
• Young people tend to get their news from social media.
• House prices are likely to rise again next year.

**Phát âm – chia cụm & ngắt hơi:** khi đọc câu dài kiểu bản tin, chia thành cụm ý và ngắt hơi ngắn giữa các cụm: According to the latest report | the unemployment rate | has fallen | for the third month in a row. Mỗi cụm có một từ được nhấn mạnh nhất (latest, unemployment, fallen, third).

**Pronunciation – chunking & pausing:** when reading long news sentences, split them into thought groups with short pauses: According to the latest report | the unemployment rate | has fallen | for the third month in a row. Each group has one main stressed word (latest, unemployment, fallen, third).

**Tự luyện ngoài app:**
• Nghe (30 phút): nghe 1 bản tin thời sự 5 phút (BBC, NPR), tóm tắt bằng 3 câu.
• Nói (30 phút): tranh luận 3 phút với chính mình – 2 lập luận ủng hộ và 2 lập luận phản đối một chính sách.
• Đọc (30 phút): đọc 1 bài xã luận, xác định quan điểm tác giả, 3 lập luận và bằng chứng đi kèm.
• Viết (45 phút): viết bài nghị luận 250 từ về già hóa dân số hoặc tin giả.
• Từ vựng (20 phút): ghi 10 cụm từ đi kèm (rise sharply, fall slightly, highly controversial…) từ bài báo đã đọc.
• Thử thách (7 ngày): mỗi sáng nghe 1 bản tin 5 phút, ghi 1 tiêu đề kèm 1 câu tóm tắt.

**Practice outside the app:**
• Listening (30 min): listen to a 5-minute news bulletin (BBC, NPR) and summarise it in 3 sentences.
• Speaking (30 min): debate with yourself for 3 minutes – 2 arguments for and 2 against a policy.
• Reading (30 min): read an editorial; identify the writer's view, 3 arguments and their evidence.
• Writing (45 min): write a 250-word opinion essay on population ageing or fake news.
• Vocabulary (20 min): note 10 collocations (rise sharply, fall slightly, highly controversial…) from an article.
• Challenge (7 days): each morning listen to a 5-minute bulletin and note 1 headline with a one-sentence summary.

warm.s: The minister said that inflation would probably fall below four percent next year, but some economists believe that this forecast is too optimistic.
q: Một số nhà kinh tế nghĩ gì về dự báo?
What do some economists think about the forecast?
e: “some economists believe that this forecast is too optimistic”. Câu tường thuật: will → would (said that inflation would fall).
“some economists believe that this forecast is too optimistic”. Reported speech: will → would (said that inflation would fall).

warm.s: According to the latest report, the unemployment rate has fallen.
e: “According to” = theo. fall → fell → fallen; hiện tại hoàn thành vì kết quả liên quan đến hiện tại.
“According to” introduces a source. fall → fell → fallen; present perfect because the result matters now.

warm.s: I don't think this policy is effective.
e: Tiếng Anh phủ định ở “think”: I don't think … is, tự nhiên hơn “I think … isn't”.
English puts the negative on “think”: I don't think … is, more natural than “I think … isn't”.

warm.s: This issue needs to be addressed as soon as possible.
e: Bị động với need: needs to be + V3. “address an issue” = giải quyết vấn đề.
Passive with need: needs to be + past participle. “address an issue” = deal with a problem.

warm.s: I usually get the news from podcasts on my way to work, but I always check important stories on two or three reliable websites before I believe them.
e: Câu hỏi: How do you usually get the news? – Gợi ý trả lời mẫu. Ngắt hơi sau “work”; “reliable” /rɪˈlaɪ.ə.bəl/ nhấn âm 2.
Question: How do you usually get the news? – Model answer. Pause after “work”; “reliable” is stressed on syllable 2.

warm.s: People can spot fake news by checking who wrote the article, looking for the original source and asking themselves whether the headline seems too shocking to be true.
e: Câu hỏi: How can people spot fake news? – Gợi ý trả lời mẫu. Chia cụm theo ba V-ing: checking … | looking for … | asking ….
Question: How can people spot fake news? – Model answer. Group the sentence by the three -ing verbs: checking … | looking for … | asking ….

rd2.tx: According to a report published last week, more than a quarter of Vietnam's population will be over sixty by 2050. The report said that the country was ageing faster than almost any other country in the region. On the one hand, people are living longer thanks to better healthcare, which is clearly good news. On the other hand, there will be fewer workers to support each retired person, and pension costs are likely to rise sharply. Urbanisation has made the situation more complicated, because many young adults have moved to big cities, while their parents tend to stay in the countryside. The government has announced that it will raise the retirement age gradually and invest more in care services for the elderly. However, some experts argue that this policy is not enough. It seems that the debate about how to care for an older society has only just begun.
rd2.tr: Theo một báo cáo được công bố tuần trước, đến năm 2050, hơn một phần tư dân số Việt Nam sẽ trên sáu mươi tuổi. Báo cáo cho biết đất nước đang già hóa nhanh hơn gần như mọi quốc gia khác trong khu vực. Một mặt, người dân sống lâu hơn nhờ chăm sóc y tế tốt hơn, đó rõ ràng là tin tốt. Mặt khác, sẽ có ít người lao động hơn để hỗ trợ mỗi người về hưu, và chi phí lương hưu có khả năng tăng mạnh. Đô thị hóa khiến tình hình phức tạp hơn, vì nhiều người trẻ đã chuyển lên các thành phố lớn, trong khi cha mẹ họ thường ở lại nông thôn. Chính phủ đã thông báo sẽ tăng dần tuổi nghỉ hưu và đầu tư nhiều hơn vào dịch vụ chăm sóc người cao tuổi. Tuy nhiên, một số chuyên gia cho rằng chính sách này là chưa đủ. Có vẻ như cuộc tranh luận về cách chăm sóc một xã hội già hơn chỉ mới bắt đầu.

q: Theo báo cáo, đến năm 2050 điều gì sẽ xảy ra?
According to the report, what will happen by 2050?
o: More than a quarter of the population will be over sixty.
Half of the population will live in big cities.
The retirement age will be sixty.
e: “more than a quarter of Vietnam's population will be over sixty by 2050” – a quarter = một phần tư.
“more than a quarter of Vietnam's population will be over sixty by 2050” – a quarter = 25%.
f: more than a quarter of Vietnam's population

q: Vì sao đô thị hóa làm tình hình phức tạp hơn?
Why has urbanisation made the situation more complicated?
o: Young adults have moved to cities while their parents stay in the countryside.
Cities have too many retired people.
e: “because many young adults have moved to big cities, while their parents tend to stay in the countryside” – con cái xa cha mẹ già.
“because many young adults have moved to big cities, while their parents tend to stay in the countryside” – children live far from ageing parents.
f: many young adults have moved to big cities

q: Một số chuyên gia nghĩ gì về chính sách của chính phủ?
What do some experts think about the government's policy?
o: It will solve the problem quickly.
e: “some experts argue that this policy is not enough”. “argue” ở đây = lập luận, cho rằng.
“some experts argue that this policy is not enough”. “argue” here = claim with reasons.

ex2.s: The minister said that prices ___ rising because of higher fuel costs, but she promised that they would fall soon. (be)
a: were
e: Câu tường thuật sau “said”: “are rising” lùi thành “were rising”. “prices” số nhiều → were.
Reported speech after “said”: “are rising” → “were rising”. “prices” is plural → were.

ex2.s: It ___ that unemployment is falling, although many new jobs are temporary and quite badly paid. (seem)
a: seems
e: “It seems that …” = có vẻ như (nói giảm nhẹ). Chủ ngữ “It” → thêm -s: seems.
“It seems that …” is a hedging phrase. With “It” add -s: seems.

ex2.s: ___ the one hand, the new law protects workers; on the other hand, it may increase costs for small businesses.
a: On
e: Cụm cố định: “On the one hand …, on the other hand …”. Không dùng “In” hay “At”.
Fixed phrase: “On the one hand …, on the other hand …”. Not “In” or “At”.

ex2.s: Young people ___ get their news from social media rather than newspapers, which makes them more exposed to fake stories.
e: “tend to + V” = có xu hướng (nói giảm nhẹ). “tend” cần “to” trước động từ; không dùng tiếp diễn ở đây.
“tend to + verb” = usually do. “tend” needs “to” before a verb; the continuous isn't used here.

ex2.s: The spokesperson told that the government would publish the full report by the end of the month.
a: The spokesperson said that the government would publish the full report by the end of the month.
The spokesperson told reporters that the government would publish the full report by the end of the month.
The spokesperson told journalists that the government would publish the full report by the end of the month.
e: “tell” luôn cần tân ngữ chỉ người (told reporters that …). Không có người nghe → dùng “said that”.
“tell” always needs a person object (told reporters that …). With no listener, use “said that”.

ex2.s: Last month the prime minister announced that the new policy will be introduced in the following year.
a: Last month the prime minister announced that the new policy would be introduced in the following year.
Last month the prime minister announced that the new policy would be introduced the following year.
e: Động từ tường thuật ở quá khứ (announced) và có “the following year” → will lùi thành “would”.
The reporting verb is past (announced) and the time is “the following year” → will becomes “would”.

ex2.s: Giá nhà ở các thành phố lớn đang tăng nhanh.
a: Housing prices in big cities are rising fast.
House prices in big cities are rising quickly.
Housing prices in large cities are rising fast.
House prices in major cities are going up fast.
e: Hiện tại tiếp diễn cho xu hướng đang diễn ra: are rising. “rise” là nội động từ (không có tân ngữ).
Present continuous for a current trend: are rising. “rise” takes no object.

ex2.s: Nhiều người trẻ không đủ tiền mua nhà.
a: Many young people can't afford to buy a home.
Many young people cannot afford to buy a house.
A lot of young people can't afford to buy a home.
Many young people can't afford a home.
e: “không đủ tiền làm gì” = can't afford to + V. Đây là cụm rất hay gặp trong tin kinh tế.
“không đủ tiền làm gì” = can't afford to + verb – very common in economic news.
f: can't afford to buy a home

q: Chuyển sang câu tường thuật, bắt đầu bằng “The report said that …”.
Change into reported speech, starting with “The report said that …”.
ex2.s: “Inequality between rural and urban areas has increased, and it will continue to grow without new investment.”
a: The report said that inequality between rural and urban areas had increased, and it would continue to grow without new investment.
The report said that inequality between rural and urban areas had increased and that it would continue to grow without new investment.
The report said that inequality between rural and urban areas had increased, and that it would continue to grow without new investment.
e: Lùi thì: has increased → had increased; will continue → would continue.
Backshift: has increased → had increased; will continue → would continue.

ex2.s: Có vẻ như tin giả lan truyền trên mạng xã hội nhanh hơn nhiều so với tin thật, nhất là khi tiêu đề gây sốc.
a: It seems that fake news spreads much faster than real news on social media, especially when the headline is shocking.
It seems that fake news spreads on social media much faster than true news, especially when the headline is shocking.
Fake news seems to spread much faster than real news on social media, especially when the headlines are shocking.
e: “Có vẻ như” = It seems that / seems to. “news” là danh từ không đếm được → động từ số ít “spreads”.
“Có vẻ như” = It seems that / seems to. “news” is uncountable → singular “spreads”.
f: It seems that fake news spreads

ex2.s: According to|the latest figures,|the unemployment rate|has fallen|for the third month in a row,|but|wages|are still rising slowly.
m: Theo số liệu mới nhất, tỷ lệ thất nghiệp đã giảm tháng thứ ba liên tiếp, nhưng lương vẫn tăng chậm.
According to the latest figures, the unemployment rate has fallen for the third month in a row, but wages are still rising slowly.
e: Nguồn tin (According to …) đứng đầu; “in a row” = liên tiếp; “still” đứng trước động từ chính.
The source (According to …) comes first; “in a row” = consecutively; “still” goes before the main verb.
f: for the third month in a row

q: Chọn 1 bài báo khoảng 300 từ, tóm tắt còn 80 từ rồi viết thêm 120 từ bình luận quan điểm của bạn.
Choose a news article of about 300 words, summarise it in 80 words, then add 120 words giving your opinion.
ex2.m:
Summary: A recent article reported that more and more young Vietnamese are moving to big cities for work. According to official figures, the urban population has grown by almost a third in ten years. The article said that this trend had created jobs and raised incomes, but it had also caused traffic jams, pollution and high housing prices. Experts quoted in the article argued that smaller cities needed more investment so that young people would have good reasons to stay.
Opinion: In my view, urbanisation is unavoidable, but it does not have to be chaotic. On the one hand, big cities offer better jobs and education, so it is natural that young people want to move there. On the other hand, if everyone goes to Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City, these cities will become impossible to live in. It seems to me that the best solution is to develop regional centres with good universities, hospitals and transport links. If the government does this, people are likely to stay closer to home, and families will not be separated.
e: Cần có: • phần tóm tắt dùng câu tường thuật (The article said that … had …) • phần bình luận có On the one hand / On the other hand • ít nhất 2 cách nói giảm nhẹ (It seems, is likely to, tend to) • kết luận và đề xuất rõ ràng.

Include: • a summary using reported speech (The article said that … had …) • an opinion section with On the one hand / On the other hand • at least 2 hedging phrases (It seems, is likely to, tend to) • a clear conclusion and suggestion.

th:
**Ngữ pháp 1 – hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn và quá khứ đơn**
• Công việc **vẫn đang làm**: I've been working at ABC since 2022. / I've been working here for three years.
• Công việc **đã kết thúc**: I worked at XYZ from 2019 to 2021. (quá khứ đơn + from … to …)
• Lỗi hay gặp: “I work here since 2022” ✗ → I've been working here since 2022 ✓.

**Grammar 1 – present perfect continuous vs past simple**
• A job you **still do**: I've been working at ABC since 2022. / I've been working here for three years.
• A job that has **ended**: I worked at XYZ from 2019 to 2021. (past simple + from … to …)
• Common mistake: “I work here since 2022” ✗ → I've been working here since 2022 ✓.

**Ngữ pháp 2 – trả lời theo STAR**
• **S**ituation – tình huống: When I was working at a café, we lost many customers.
• **T**ask – nhiệm vụ: My task was to bring them back.
• **A**ction – hành động: I started a loyalty card and posted daily offers.
• **R**esult – kết quả: Within three months, sales had increased by 20%.
• Cụm hữu ích: I'm good at + V-ing, I'm interested in …, My main strength is …

**Grammar 2 – answering with STAR**
• **S**ituation: When I was working at a café, we lost many customers.
• **T**ask: My task was to bring them back.
• **A**ction: I started a loyalty card and posted daily offers.
• **R**esult: Within three months, sales had increased by 20%.
• Useful phrases: I'm good at + -ing, I'm interested in …, My main strength is …

**Phát âm**
• Đọc năm: 2022 = **twenty twenty-two**; 2019 = twenty nineteen; 2005 = two thousand and five.
• Nói rõ âm cuối: worked /wɝːkt/, managed /ˈmæn.ɪdʒd/, skills /skɪlz/ – người nghe phỏng vấn đánh giá cao độ rõ ràng.
• résumé /ˈrez.ə.meɪ/ – trọng âm đầu.

**Pronunciation**
• Saying years: 2022 = **twenty twenty-two**; 2019 = twenty nineteen; 2005 = two thousand and five.
• Pronounce final sounds clearly: worked /wɝːkt/, managed /ˈmæn.ɪdʒd/, skills /skɪlz/ – interviewers value clear speech.
• résumé /ˈrez.ə.meɪ/ – stress on the first syllable.

**Tự luyện ngoài app**
• Nghe (25 phút): xem 1 video phỏng vấn mẫu, ghi lại 5 câu hỏi và cách ứng viên trả lời.
• Nói (40 phút): trả lời 5 câu hỏi phổ biến (giới thiệu bản thân, điểm mạnh, điểm yếu, vì sao chọn công ty, mục tiêu 5 năm), mỗi câu 1 phút, ghi âm.
• Đọc (20 phút): đọc 3 tin tuyển dụng, gạch chân yêu cầu bắt buộc và quyền lợi.
• Viết (50 phút): viết CV 1 trang + thư xin việc 150–200 từ cho 1 tin tuyển dụng thật.
• Từ vựng (15 phút): học 15 động từ hành động cho CV (managed, led, improved …).
• Thử thách: phỏng vấn thử 15 phút với bạn học hoặc trợ lý AI, ghi âm và tự chấm 1–5 điểm: trôi chảy, từ vựng, ngữ pháp, phát âm.

**Practice outside the app**
• Listening (25 min): watch a sample interview video; note 5 questions and how the candidate answers.
• Speaking (40 min): answer 5 common questions (about yourself, strengths, weaknesses, why this company, 5-year goals), 1 minute each, and record yourself.
• Reading (20 min): read 3 job ads; underline the requirements and the benefits.
• Writing (50 min): write a one-page CV + a 150–200-word cover letter for a real job ad.
• Vocabulary (15 min): learn 15 action verbs for CVs (managed, led, improved …).
• Challenge: do a 15-minute mock interview with a friend or an AI assistant, record it and score yourself 1–5 for fluency, vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation.

a formal meeting to decide if you get a job
formally ask to be given a job

the pay you hope to receive
